parsed.reason: This is a perfect reminder line for an hour-ahead notification. It's a single, calm sentence that frames the upcoming event ("A soccer morning ahead") without restating the time, which will appear in large type below. It sounds natural and human—like a friend checking in—rather than a notification. It makes no assumptions about preparation, packing, travel time, or anything else not given. It simply acknowledges what's coming and stops. For an hour-out reminder with no lead time for preparation, this is exactly what a good reminder does.
